name: Hitomi no Rakuin 4 ~Etsujoku no Soushin Kaizou~
original_name: 瞳の烙淫4 ～悦辱の操心改造～
source:
The protagonist, Sawamatsu Yuuki (name changeable), possessed a unique ability: the power to induce illusions in those he locked eyes with.

This extraordinary ability caught the attention of the head of the prestigious conglomerate, Kanba, who quickly recruited him. Thanks to the sheer utility of his power, Yuuki was often used as a convenient tool for the company’s benefit. Yet, at the same time, he was trusted and given opportunities to fully utilize his otherwise overwhelming ability. As a close aide, he found a sense of fulfillment in his role.

However, everything changed when the head of Kanba suddenly passed away, leaving his granddaughter, Kanba Kisara, to take over. Naturally, the atmosphere within the company shifted dramatically. Kisara’s methods, starkly different from her predecessor’s, began driving the company’s success. Even Yuuki, who had witnessed the former head’s leadership up close, couldn’t help but respect her skills.

But Yuuki wasn’t entirely pleased with the new state of affairs. With the former head gone, there was no one left who could rival Kisara’s influence. The thought of stepping up and taking control himself began to simmer in his mind.

There were, however, a few problems. For one, his ability didn’t seem to work on Kisara. Worse, anyone under his influence would have their illusions dispelled the moment they got close to her. On top of that, Kisara seemed to suspect that Yuuki had some kind of special power.

If his ability alone could break through, it would’ve been easy. But since it didn’t work on her, he’d need to find another way. This wasn’t something he could pull off alone. He’d have to rely on Akatsuki Ririka, his trusted right-hand woman since his days as the former head’s aide, and leverage connections across the board.

And so, Yuuki made up his mind: he would drag Kisara down from her position as head of Kanba and stage a coup to claim the top spot for himself.

“This time, it’s my turn to stand at the top.”

translation:
主角泽松佑纪（化名）拥有一种独特的能力：让目光所及的人产生幻觉的能力。

这种非凡的能力引起了著名企业集团老板坎巴的注意，并很快招募了他。由于他权力的纯粹实用性，有纪经常被用作为公司谋取利益的便利工具。然而，与此同时，他受到信任并有机会充分发挥他的压倒性能力。作为一名亲密助手，他在自己的角色中找到了成就感。

然而，当坎巴的掌门人突然去世后，一切都发生了变化，由他的孙女坎巴木更接任。自然，公司内部的气氛发生了巨大的变化。基萨拉的方法与她的前任截然不同，开始推动公司取得成功。即使是近距离目睹了前任社长领导能力的有纪，也忍不住对她的能力表示敬佩。

但有纪对新的事态并不完全满意。前任首脑没了之后，就没有人能与木更的影响力相抗衡了。他的心中开始酝酿着要站出来掌控自己的想法。

然而，也存在一些问题。其一，他的能力似乎对木更不起作用。更糟糕的是，任何受他影响的人，在靠近她的那一刻，幻想都会破灭。除此之外，木更似乎怀疑有纪拥有某种特殊的力量。

如果单凭他的能力就能突破，那是轻而易举的事情。但既然这对她不起作用，他就得想别的办法了。这不是他一个人能够完成的事情。他必须依靠晓莉莉香，她是他从担任前任校长助手以来一直信赖的得力助手，并利用全面的关系。

于是，有纪下定决心：他要把木更从关场首领的位置上拉下来，发动政变，为自己夺取第一的位置。

“这一次，轮到我站在顶端了。”
